name: task_update
description: Update an existing task. Can change status, owner, subject, description, and blocking relationships. Set status to "deleted" to remove a task. Setting status to "in_progress" auto-assigns you as owner if no owner is set.

taskId.description: ID of the task to update.

owner.description: New owner agent name. Set to empty string to unassign.

metadata.description: Metadata to merge. Set a key to null to delete it.

addBlocks.description: Task IDs that this task blocks.

addBlockedBy.description: Task IDs that block this task.
